citrini's analyst #3 rode a speedboat 18 miles from the iranian coast to count ships with a leica camera. i respect the hustle lol 

his finding: AIS misses ~50% of actual traffic. ppl screaming oil top, ahhhhhh we’re saved 

ok. double the ships. 16 becomes 32. pre-war was 138

that's still a 77% reduction

and if those extra barrels were actually reaching the market, why are all these countries in crisis right now?

philippines — year long energy emergency
pakistan — 5 days of fuel left
sri lanka — turned off all street lights
australia — free public transport to save gas
italy — airports restricting jet fuel
south korea — vehicle restrictions first time since 1997
japan — refineries at 69% utilization
vietnam — tapping stabilization fund
thailand — oil fund blown
myanmar — alternating driving days
slowenia — first european country rationing
germany — warning of shortages
ethiopia — no gas at all

you can't fake 15+ countries rationing simultaneously

the dark ships he counted are iranian ghost fleet and sanctioned tankers paying $2 mil tolls in yuan or crypto. that oil isn’t reaching countries in crisis

slightly less catastrophic is still catastrophic
